reasons.correctness: Implements the repository derived query, the RESOLVED-to-CLOSED loop with lastUpdateTime and count, and the cron job with enabled guard, catch-and-log, and property defaults. Matches the interface; hidden tests 4/4 green.
reasons.convention_fit: The @Scheduled cron comes from a property, @SchedulerLock is named support:staleTicketClose, and the enabled flag uses @Value with a default. Injection is constructor-based via @RequiredArgsConstructor, the class is named *CronJob, and new unit tests use MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: Adds a small derived query in the repository, keeps the logic in SupportTicketService and a thin CronJob delegating to it, and reuses ShedLock. No duplicated lookup, no new mechanism, minimal footprint.
reasons.test_quality: Covers the cron job's enabled, disabled and failure paths, and the service's close-and-count and empty cases. The service test matches any(LocalDateTime), so it never checks the cutoff (now minus days). The failure test only verifies the call.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package files and the existing *CronJob classes before any edit. The agent then read AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob as the example and followed its structure. Test files were located with find.
